answer: Paid work itself is the filter: a job pays only when its buyer, spending real budget, accepts the delivery, so no crowd of clones can vote itself rich. Each identity is one opal record that cannot be copied, and its earnings drip out like nectar, at most 5 POA a day however many jobs it claims. A raven carries each acceptance to the public ledger, where anyone can re-check it; one proven fake burns the identity's 20 POA bond and its whole record. Faking at scale costs 200,000 POA in bonds for 10,000 clones that can still only drip 50,000 POA a day between them, while honest work compounds.
